meta.title: Unmeta — remove hidden data from photos and files
meta.description: Strip location, phone model, author name and other hidden data from photos, videos and documents. Right in your browser — your files never leave your device.

start.title: Your files say more than you think. Let’s fix that.
start.subtitle: Photos, videos and documents quietly record where they were taken, on what, by whom and when. We’ll show you what’s there and remove what shouldn’t be.
start.drop: Drop photos, videos or documents here
start.multipleHint: Add as many files as you like, or a whole folder
start.multipleHintMobile: You can pick several at once
start.labelNote: Hidden inside — you can’t see it in the photo

start.privacy: Your files never leave your device — everything happens right in your browser.
start.whatIsHiddenBody: When you take a photo or save a file, your phone and apps quietly tuck extra details inside it — this is called metadata. It can include the exact spot where it was taken, your phone’s model and serial number, even your name. You can’t see it in the picture, but anyone who gets the file can read it.

modes.remembered: We’ll remember this on this device

maximum.name: Maximum
maximum.for: Removes everything it can. For files going online or to people you don’t know.

balanced.name: Balanced
balanced.for: Removes the personal bits, keeps dates and captions. For friends and family.

privateOnly.name: Private only
privateOnly.for: Removes location and device, leaves the rest. When you want to keep your credit.

progress.loadingTool: Loading the video and audio cleaner — just once, about {size}
progress.loadingToolHint: This is the cleaning tool itself. Your files aren’t sent anywhere.

plainText.title: No hidden data inside
plainText.body: Text files have nowhere to hide details about you. Just check the text itself — we don’t touch it.

unsupported.title: We can’t clean this kind of file yet
unsupported.body: We’d rather say so than promise it’s clean. Your file is untouched.
unsupported.tip: Tip: save it in another format — a document as PDF, a photo as JPEG — and we can clean it.

bigFile.title: Big file — {size}
bigFile.body: This device might run out of memory. Give it a try? If it doesn’t work, no harm done — your original stays safe.

tooLarge.title: This file is too big — {size}
tooLarge.body: Browsers can handle files up to {limit}, and this one is larger. That’s a browser limit, not something you did wrong.
tooLarge.mobileHint: Computers can handle more — try it there.

errors.title: That didn’t work
errors.generic: Something went wrong. Try again — your original hasn’t changed.
errors.readFailed: We couldn’t open this file. It may be damaged, or still downloading from the cloud.
errors.cleanFailed: We couldn’t clean this file. We left it untouched — don’t share it as clean.
errors.outOfMemory: Your device ran out of memory. Close other tabs and try again — or one file at a time.
errors.toolLoadFailed: We couldn’t load the cleaning tool. Check your connection and reload the page. Your files aren’t sent anywhere either way.
errors.zipFailed: We couldn’t build the ZIP. Download the files one by one instead.
errors.downloadFailed: The download didn’t work. Try again.
errors.shareFailed: We couldn’t open the Share menu. Use Download instead.
errors.browserOld: Your browser is too old for Unmeta. Update it or open the site in another browser.
errors.folderFailed: We couldn’t read that folder. Choose the files inside it instead.

empty.noFilesHint: Add some files and we’ll show you what’s hiding inside.

footer.promise: Your files never leave your device.
